objective: Find and repair the local source defects that prevent the AI Commander and release control plane from completing exact-SHA staging validation. Reproduce authorization, registry, queue, executor, credential, reconcile, runtime-identity, and evidence failures locally before any Cloudflare proof.
acceptance_criteria: All configured local deterministic checks pass from the exact base SHA.
Known authorization-before-create and authorization-before-reconcile failures have regression coverage.
Missing or insufficient credentials fail with a layer-specific code and never become an opaque failed state.
No production, Cloudflare deployment, GitHub Actions, secret, DNS, Access, database, customer-send, or external-send mutation occurs.
The runner creates one local candidate commit and immutable local evidence bound to that exact candidate SHA.
commit_message: feat(debug-fabric): add local AI Commander debug candidate
